setup.title: Set up the first admin
setup.invalid.heading: This link does not work
setup.invalid.text: The link is invalid, expired or already used.
setup.account.heading: Create the admin account
setup.account.intro: This link works once. First the account, then two-factor authentication. Both are required.
field.username.hint: 3 to 32 characters: a to z, 0 to 9, dot, underscore, hyphen. It can never be changed or reused.
field.password.hint: At least 15 characters, no other rules. A long phrase is easier to remember than a short mess.
setup.totp.heading: Set up two-factor authentication
setup.totp.intro: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6 digit code it shows.
setup.totp.qr.alt: QR code for the authenticator app
setup.totp.manual: Cannot scan? Enter this key in your app:
setup.done.heading: Admin account created
setup.done.intro: These recovery codes are your way back in if you lose your authenticator app. Each works once.
setup.done.warning: They are shown only now. Store them somewhere safe, for example in a password manager.
setup.done.confirm: I have saved the recovery codes.
error.invalid_link: The link is invalid, expired or already used.
error.username_invalid: The username is not allowed. Use 3 to 32 characters: a to z, 0 to 9, dot, underscore, hyphen.
error.email_invalid: This email address does not look valid.
error.email_taken: This email address is already in use.
error.password_too_short: The password needs at least 15 characters.
error.password_too_long: The password can have at most 128 characters.
error.totp_code_invalid: The code is wrong or expired. Check the time on your phone and try the next code.
error.totp_not_prepared: Please start the two-factor setup again.
error.server_error: Something went wrong on the server. Try again later.
